name: Sign of the Dawnflower
levelText: cleric 0, druid 0, hunter 0, oracle 0, paladin 1, ranger 1, warpriest 0 (Sarenrae)
componentsText: S, F (your holy symbol, or a depiction of either Sarenrae's holy symbol or the goddess herself)
description: As message, except the only information you can transmit is that you are a worshiper of Sarenrae. Once notified, the target can reply that he understands your sign. The spell transmits meaning, not sound, and transcends language barriers.
